tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You are a member of a local gym called Fitness Zone. Recently, you have noticed that some of the exercise equipment is problematic. You want to suggest this to the gym manager, Ms. Taylor. Write an email to Ms. Taylor.
bullets: Describe the issues you have noticed with the current equipment.
Provide reasons for why adding new equipment would improve the gym experience.
Explain the consequences on membership of not improving the services.
tasks.subject: Suggestion for updating gym equipment
